title: PlanState
description: Live coordination state for the Valory orchestrator. Mirrors the work-decomposition tree's runtime: the task DAG, per-task status, dispatched workers, result-file pointers, and the optional File/Unit implementation grain. Persisted at plan/state.json so a long-running orchestrator survives compaction. See docs/agentic-architecture.md.

mission.description: One-line statement of the root ask this effort serves (mirror of plan/root.md).

current_phase.description: The sprint or phase currently being executed (e.g. 'G1-S1 (Sprint 25)').

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last reconciliation of this state against the plan tree.

tasks.description: The task DAG. Each entry is a level-3 task with its scheduling and acceptance state, optionally grained into Files (5a) and Units (5b).

id.description: Canonical task id in the form G<goal>-S<sprint>-T<task> (e.g. G1-S1-T1).

sprint.description: The sprint this task belongs to (e.g. G1-S1).

status.description: Lifecycle status. A task with unresolved depends_on is not dispatchable.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must reach status 'done' before this task is dispatchable.

assigned_worker.description: The contributor agent dispatched against this task (e.g. senior-engineer), or null if unassigned.

verifier.description: The acceptance gate(s) for this task (e.g. 'SQE + Systems Engineer').

artifact_path.description: Pointer to the worker's result — an artifact directory or the source paths touched. Null until produced.

acceptance.description: Verdict from the review pipeline (the level-4 acceptance facet).

requirements.description: Requirement IDs this task implements, for traceability.

blockers.description: Why this task is blocked or failed, if applicable.

files.description: Optional level-5a implementation grain: the task decomposed into File nodes, one per source file it creates or edits. Present only when a task spans multiple files; a single-file task needs no entries here. Dispatching one worker per File makes 'no two workers edit the same file' structural. A File is finer than a Go-package 'module' (a module contains many Files).

id.description: Canonical File id in the form <task>-F<NN> (e.g. G1-S1-T1-F01).

path.description: The single source file this File node realizes (e.g. internal/admin/oversight_handler.go).

status.description: Lifecycle status of this File's implementation.

assigned_worker.description: The worker dispatched against this File, or null if unassigned. One worker per File.

units.description: Optional level-5b grain: the File decomposed into Unit nodes, one per coherent chunk (a function, type, handler, migration block, test group, or include:: section). The smallest reviewable piece.

id.description: Canonical Unit id in the form <file>-U<MM> (e.g. G1-S1-T1-F01-U01).

title.description: Short description of the chunk this Unit realizes.

requirements.description: Requirement IDs this Unit satisfies, for chunk-level traceability.

acceptance.description: Verdict for this Unit from the review pipeline.
